name: Language Leap
summary:
Language Leap helps A1-A2 English learners practise real conversations in virtual reality.

Step into six everyday places and complete simple tasks with friendly characters:
- Hotel - check in and get your room key
- Airport - check in, go through security and fix a missed flight
- Restaurant - order a meal and pay the bill
- Shopping - the Green Cart Challenge: choose greener products
- Banking - The Lost Card: report a lost card
- Hospital - The Sprained Wrist: talk to a nurse, a doctor and a pharmacist
